Slow-roast lamb shoulder with lemon and oregano

Six hours, one tray, falling off the bone. Serves 6.

Ingredients

  • 2 kg lamb shoulder, bone in
  • 4 lemons, halved
  • 6 garlic cloves, smashed
  • 3 tbsp dried oregano
  • 125 ml olive oil
  • Flaky salt and cracked pepper

Method

  1. Heat the oven to 160°C. Salt the lamb all over and rest it for 30 minutes.
  2. Scatter the lemons, garlic and half the oregano in a deep tray. Sit the lamb on top, drizzle with oil and cover tightly with foil.
    • No deep tray? A roasting pan with a wire rack works.
  3. Roast for 5 hours, then uncover, scatter the remaining oregano and roast for 1 more hour until the edges crisp.
  4. Rest for 20 minutes. Serve with the tray juices and warm flatbreads.

Notes

Leftovers keep for 3 days refrigerated and shred beautifully into pasta sauce.
